focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞的半導體製造、設備與資料中心
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor manufacturing, equipment and data centers

throughline.zh: 台灣及新加坡公布製造業產出，台積電子公司披露德州晶圓設廠申請，馬來西亞則有資料中心工程簽約與出口規則回應。
throughline.en: Taiwan and Singapore reported manufacturing output, a TSMC unit disclosed its Texas fab application, and Malaysia saw a data center award and a response to U.S. listing changes.

text.zh: 台灣 10 月製造業生產年增 31.63%，其中電腦、電子產品及光學製品業年增 130.57%。
text.en: Taiwan’s October manufacturing output grew 31.63% year over year, with computer, electronic and optical products up 130.57%.

text.zh: 台積電子公司提出德州租稅優惠申請，申請表 A 表列約 216.55 億美元投資規劃，仍待審查與最終投資決定。
text.en: TSMC’s subsidiary applied for Texas tax incentives. Schedule A lists US$21.66 billion in planned investment, pending approvals and a final decision.

text.zh: 美國先行公開 7 家實體的列名文件。馬來西亞確認其中兩家為當地實體，並稱將通知資料中心業者。
text.en: The U.S. released a seven-entry Entity List rule for public inspection. Malaysia identified two local entities and said it would notify data center operators.

text.zh: KJTS 簽署 6,800 萬令吉波德申資料中心機械工程分包，兩份合約合計 1.16 億令吉。
text.en: KJTS signed a RM68 million mechanical works subcontract in Port Dickson, bringing the two awards to RM116 million.

text.zh: 新加坡第三季製造業年增 8.5%，經季節調整後季減 0.2%；電子與精密工程產出獲 AI 相關需求支撐。
text.en: Singapore’s Q3 manufacturing grew 8.5% year over year and fell 0.2% from Q2 after seasonal adjustment. AI demand supported electronics and precision engineering.

title.zh: 台灣 10 月製造業生產指數年增 31.63%，電腦電子及光學製品業年增 130.57%
title.en: Taiwan’s October manufacturing output rises 31.63% as computer, electronic and optical products gain 130.57%

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 24 日公布，台灣 10 月工業生產指數為 151.30，年增 29.80%；製造業生產指數為 154.61，年增 31.63%。電腦、電子產品及光學製品業年增 130.57%，經濟部點名伺服器、交換器及半導體檢測設備增產。
summary.en: Taiwan’s economic ministry reported on November 24 that October industrial production reached an index of 151.30, up 29.80% year over year, and manufacturing reached 154.61, up 31.63%. Computer, electronic and optical products rose 130.57%, with the ministry citing higher production of servers, switches and semiconductor inspection equipment.

text.zh: 經濟部將電子零組件與電腦電子及光學製品分開統計。電子零組件業 10 月年增 25.39%，其中積體電路業年增 31.19%；產品涵蓋晶圓代工、封測、DRAM 與 IC 載板。
text.en: The ministry records electronic components separately from computers, electronic products and optical products. Electronic components rose 25.39% and integrated circuits rose 31.19% year over year, with the supply chain spanning foundries, packaging and testing, DRAM and IC substrates.

text.zh: 經濟部圖表將去年 10 月製造業指數列為 117.46。今年前十月工業生產指數為 134.94，年增 21.52%；製造業指數 137.42，年增 22.88%。10 月機械設備業年增 26.85%，化學材料及肥料業年減 2.80%。
text.en: The ministry’s chart gives 117.46 as the manufacturing index in October 2025. From January to October 2026, industrial production reached 134.94, up 21.52%, and manufacturing reached 137.42, up 22.88%. October machinery output rose 26.85%, while chemical materials and fertilizers fell 2.80%.

title.zh: 台積電子公司申請德州租稅優惠，申請表列 216.55 億美元投資規劃
title.en: TSMC subsidiary applies for Texas tax incentive and lists US$21.66 billion in planned investment

summary.zh: 美國德州布拉索斯郡 11 月 23 日確認，台積電子公司 TSMC Arizona 就擬議晶圓園區提出州稅優惠申請，申請表列 2027 至 2031 年投資合計約 216.55 億美元。場址仍在評估，計畫須經州與學區審查，並由台積電作最後投資決定。
summary.en: Brazos County, Texas, confirmed on November 23 that TSMC Arizona had applied for state tax incentives for a proposed wafer fab campus. The application lists about US$21.66 billion in investment from 2027 to 2031, with site selection, public approvals and TSMC’s final decision still pending.

text.zh: 申請文件的經濟影響報告將產品規劃列為 2 奈米或更先進製程的邏輯晶片。公司表示，也在評估亞利桑那州既有據點的擴產選項。
text.en: An economic impact report accompanying the application describes logic chips using 2 nm or more advanced processes. The company is also evaluating expansion at its existing Arizona campus.

text.zh: 申請表以 2027 年開工、2031 年開始商轉為規劃情境。布拉索斯郡說明，州計畫須由州審計長審查，並由州長與學區董事會核准；若有郡級優惠，將另行審議。
text.en: The filing assumes construction in 2027 and commercial operations in 2031. The county says the state comptroller must review the proposal before approval by the governor and the school district board. Any county incentives would be considered separately.

title.zh: 美國先行公開新增 7 家實體名單，馬來西亞主管機關列兩家當地實體
title.en: U.S. previews seven Entity List additions and Malaysia identifies two locally based entities

summary.zh: 美國工業暨安全局文件列出 7 家將新增至實體清單的東南亞相關實體，聯邦公報預定於美國時間 11 月 25 日正式刊登。馬來西亞投資、貿易及工業部 11 月 24 日表示，其中兩家是在馬來西亞的實體，並稱將通知當地資料中心業者。
summary.en: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security made available a rule listing seven new Entity List entries tied to Southeast Asian destinations, scheduled for publication on November 25 U.S. time. Malaysia’s trade ministry said on November 24 that two are Malaysian entities and that local data center operators would be notified.

text.zh: 美方文件把 MSFusion、Speedmatrix 及 PT Megaspeed International 列於馬來西亞項下，另列新加坡 3 家及泰國 1 家。馬來西亞主管機關確認 MSFusion 及 Speedmatrix 為當地實體，並表示依其投資發展局紀錄，PT Megaspeed International 在當地既未設立，也未營運或承租資料中心。
text.en: The U.S. document places MSFusion, Speedmatrix and PT Megaspeed International under Malaysia, with three entries under Singapore and one under Thailand. Malaysia identified MSFusion and Speedmatrix as local entities and said its investment authority’s records do not identify PT Megaspeed International as a Malaysian entity, data center operator or tenant.

text.zh: 美國文件對列名實體涉及的美國出口管理規則管制品設定許可要求。馬來西亞投資發展局將通知當地資料中心業者，並建議勿向名單上的實體出租空間或提供服務。
text.en: The U.S. document sets license requirements for listed entities covering items subject to its Export Administration Regulations. Malaysia’s trade ministry said the investment authority would advise operators against leasing space or providing services to the listed entities.

title.zh: KJTS 簽下波德申第二座資料中心機械工程分包，合約值 6,800 萬令吉
title.en: KJTS signs RM68 million mechanical works subcontract for second Port Dickson data center

summary.zh: 馬來西亞 KJTS 11 月 23 日公告，子公司 KJ Technical Services 與 Gamuda Engineering 簽署 6,800 萬令吉分包合約，負責森美蘭州波德申第二座大型資料中心的機械工程。兩份分包合約合計 1.16 億令吉，金額為合約值。
summary.en: On November 23, Malaysia’s KJTS disclosed a RM68 million subcontract between KJ Technical Services and Gamuda Engineering for mechanical works at a second hyperscale data center in Port Dickson, Negeri Sembilan. The two subcontracts are worth RM116 million combined.

text.zh: Gamuda 為發包方，KJTS 透過全資子公司承作機械工程。11 月 19 日公布的首份分包合約為 4,800 萬令吉。
text.en: Gamuda awarded the mechanical scope to a wholly owned KJTS subsidiary. The first subcontract, announced on November 19, was worth RM48 million.

text.zh: KJTS 列出新案兩階段實質完工日期，分別為 2028 年 4 月 22 日及 7 月 22 日。這些日期是分包工程里程碑，公告未列資料中心啟用日期。
text.en: KJTS lists substantial completion milestones of April 22 and July 22, 2028 for the two phases of the new subcontract. The announcement did not give an opening date for the data center.

title.zh: 新加坡第三季製造業年增 8.5%，季調後季減 0.2%
title.en: Singapore Q3 manufacturing grows 8.5% year on year and falls 0.2% quarter on quarter

summary.zh: 新加坡能源、貿易與工業部 11 月 24 日公布，第三季製造業產出年增 8.5%，季節調整後季減 0.2%。部會指出，電子與精密工程受全球 AI 相關需求支撐。
summary.en: Singapore’s Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry reported on November 24 that Q3 manufacturing grew 8.5% year over year and fell 0.2% quarter over quarter after seasonal adjustment. It said global AI-related demand supported electronics and precision engineering.

text.zh: 部會報告指出，電子、精密工程、運輸工程及一般製造產出增加，抵銷化學品與生醫製造減產。第二季製造業年增率為 13.2%。
text.en: The survey said gains in electronics, precision engineering, transport engineering and general manufacturing outweighed declines in chemicals and biomedical manufacturing. Manufacturing had grown 13.2% year over year in Q2.

text.zh: 第三季實質 GDP 年增 6.1%，高於 10 月公布的初估 5.4%。部會將 2026 年經濟成長預測由 4.5% 至 5.5% 上調至約 6.0%，並估 2027 年成長 2.5% 至 4.5%。
text.en: Real GDP rose 6.1% year over year in Q3, above the October advance estimate of 5.4%. The ministry raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast from 4.5% to 5.5% to around 6.0% and projected 2.5% to 4.5% for 2027.

title.zh: 馬來西亞 Sunway 選用 HPE 私有雲平台，規劃在集團環境部署 AI
title.en: Malaysia’s Sunway chooses HPE private cloud for group-wide AI deployment

summary.zh: HPE 11 月 24 日在吉隆坡宣布，馬來西亞 Sunway 集團選用 HPE Private Cloud AI，規劃讓各事業共用本身管理的 AI 環境。平台結合 HPE 基礎設施與 NVIDIA 運算及軟體，客戶未公布機櫃或加速卡數量。
summary.en: HPE announced in Kuala Lumpur on November 24 that Malaysia’s Sunway Group selected HPE Private Cloud AI for a shared environment governed by the group. The platform combines HPE infrastructure with NVIDIA computing and software. Rack and accelerator counts were not disclosed.

text.zh: HPE 表示，平台整合加速運算、網路和企業 AI 軟體，並可供多個事業單位共用。Sunway Digital & Technology 表示，集團要把資料留在自己的環境管理。
text.en: HPE said the platform integrates accelerated computing, networking and enterprise AI software and can serve multiple divisions. Sunway Digital & Technology said the project is designed to retain data within the group’s environment.

text.zh: HPE 列出知識助理與內部生產力工具等規劃用途，並表示其服務部門將提供工程和訓練。馬新社同日報導此項選型。
text.en: HPE listed knowledge assistants and internal productivity tools as planned uses and said its services arm would provide engineering and training. Bernama reported the selection the same day.

title.zh: 東佑達在台中說明六軸光耦合平台，定位共同封裝光學應用
title.en: TOYO outlines six-axis optical alignment platform for co-packaged optics at Taichung expo

summary.zh: 東佑達 11 月 24 日在台中無人載具暨機器人應用展說明，正開發六軸光耦合對位平台，用於光纖和光學元件的精密對準。公司表示將配合客戶開發進度驗證與整合，未公布驗收結果。
summary.en: At the Taichung Unmanned Systems and Robotics Expo on November 24, TOYO discussed a six-axis optical coupling and alignment platform under development for precise positioning of fibers and optics. It plans to work with customers on validation and integration, with no acceptance results disclosed.

text.zh: 光學對位會用到精密傳動、運動控制與定位。公司同場也介紹電動缸、線性馬達模組及多軸定位平台，對應晶圓搬運、精密檢測及先進封裝。
text.en: Optical alignment uses precision motion and positioning. At the same event TOYO described electric cylinders, linear motors and multi-axis positioning platforms for wafer handling, inspection and advanced packaging.

text.zh: 經濟日報引述東佑達，公司將六軸平台用於矽光子和高速光通訊的對位需求。展館確認本展於 11 月 24 日至 27 日在臺中國際會展中心舉行。
text.en: Economic Daily News quoted TOYO on the platform’s role in silicon photonics and high-speed optical communications. The venue lists the expo from November 24 to 27 at Taichung International Convention and Exhibition Center.

title.zh: 馬來西亞公布東協關鍵礦物合作措施，擬在三國試行投資工具包
title.en: Malaysia outlines ASEAN critical minerals program with a three-country investment toolkit pilot

summary.zh: 馬來西亞天然資源及環境永續部長 11 月 24 日在吉隆坡東協礦物會議開幕活動提出 8 項合作措施，包括區域關鍵礦物清單，以及在印尼、越南及馬來西亞試行礦物項目投資準備工具包。措施聚焦投資準備與下游材料加工，未宣布個別工廠案。
summary.en: Malaysia’s natural resources and environmental sustainability minister outlined eight cooperation measures at an ASEAN minerals meeting in Kuala Lumpur on November 24. They include a regional critical minerals list and a project preparation toolkit pilot in Indonesia, Vietnam and Malaysia, with no individual plant project announced.

text.zh: 東協 11 月 15 日在馬尼拉通過關鍵礦物宣言，要求發展區域策略，涵蓋開採、加工、精煉、製造與回收。11 月 24 日公布的措施補充了執行安排。
text.en: ASEAN adopted a critical minerals declaration in Manila on November 15, calling for a regional strategy spanning mining, processing, refining, manufacturing and recycling. The November 24 measures added implementation details.

text.zh: The Edge Malaysia 引述部長指出，清單涵蓋 30 種礦物，投資準備工具包將先行試辦，區域採用預定於 2027 年。另規劃以 AMConnect 提供礦物資料及投資機會資訊。
text.en: The Edge Malaysia reported that the list covers 30 minerals and the toolkit will be piloted before planned regional adoption in 2027. The minister also outlined AMConnect as a platform for mineral data and investment opportunity information.
